meta.title: Angle Perception
meta.subTitle: Angle Perception
meta.desc: Eliminate distractions with minimalist line drawings. Develop sharp intuitions for angles and parallel lines via estimation, 2AFC comparison, and parallel detection.

angle_estimation.title: Angle Estimation
angle_estimation.desc: Observe the angle formed by two rays and estimate its degree using a slider (0°~180°).
angle_estimation.instruction: Observe the two rays and adjust the slider to match the true angle (0°~180°).

angle_comparison_2afc.title: Angle 2AFC Comparison
angle_comparison_2afc.desc: Quickly identify which side has a larger angle under non-orthogonal orientations (2AFC).

angle_parallel_2afc.title: Parallel Alignment
angle_parallel_2afc.desc: Observe the prompt orientation and identify the strictly parallel line below (2AFC).
angle_parallel_2afc.instruction: Find the line that is strictly parallel to the prompt line (Keys 1 / 2).

views.estimationHint: Observe the angle formed by rays and modulate the slider to match (0°~180°)
views.comparisonHint: Identify which side contains a larger angle (Keys 1 / 2)
views.parallelHint: Observe the prompt line and select the parallel one below (Keys 1 / 2)
